name: quickie-scroll
description: Cinematic scroll-driven Next.js sites and Flutter/Android apps, from a renderable markdown prompt pack.

plugins.name: quickie-scroll
plugins.description: Scroll drives a real camera through a photoreal world. Interviews for target, look, camera architecture, chapters; designs the four-to-five-section page after the film itself instead of asking; generates one start image and chains every later scene off the previous clip's last frame; writes seven-block image-to-video prompts that render in any tool; scaffolds a Next.js project with the scrub engine and Lenis smooth scroll, or — after probing for a Flutter/Android SDK — a dependency-free 9:16 mobile app.
